hotspots.title: July 2011
hotspots.body: The final film opened in July 2011, a decade after the first, and in 3D as well as 2D.

hotspots.title: The biggest of them all
hotspots.body: It broke the record for the largest worldwide opening weekend at the time and became the highest-grossing film of the series, with well over a billion dollars.

hotspots.title: The bridge falls
hotspots.body: The long wooden bridge across the ravine is destroyed in the battle, cutting the castle off from the hillside. Its broken span is the first thing you see at dawn.

hotspots.title: Breaking the model
hotspots.body: For the battle, parts of the castle model were built again in a damaged state, with collapsed towers and scorched walls.

hotspots.title: A dragon's escape
hotspots.body: The break-in at the wizarding bank ends with a half-blind dragon smashing its way up through the roof and carrying the friends away.

hotspots.title: Nineteen years, filmed twice
hotspots.body: The epilogue at King's Cross was filmed on location, then reshot later at the studio with revised make-up for the older characters.

hotspots.title: A memory poured out
hotspots.body: A dying man's memories, seen in a stone basin, reveal a lifetime of hidden loyalty. The film builds it into a montage spanning the whole series.

hotspots.title: Walking into the forest
hotspots.body: Harry walks alone into the dark wood, accompanied by the people he has lost. It is the quietest scene of a very loud film.

hotspots.title: Three nominations
hotspots.body: It was nominated for Academy Awards for art direction, make-up and visual effects.

hotspots.title: Ten years, eight films
hotspots.body: From 2001 to 2011 the same core cast and much of the same crew made eight films at Leavesden Studios, the longest-running film series of its kind.

hotspots.title: Back to school
hotspots.body: Every 1 September the story begins again for someone. This note unlocks on the first day of term.
